# Proposed generated Windows interrupted-owner observation

The next unit can connect the frozen repair02 core to the existing native runtime-owner bootstrap. It needs a separate interrupted-run receipt contract before execution: the primary child is deliberately terminated after its second authenticated segment reply and may never write its final JSON. Reusing the successful cancellation wrapper unchanged would fail or falsely claim graceful child retirement.

This is planning only. No admission, run, source derivative or native invocation was created. Root reported author fake28 passing 28 cases and 57 subtests in actual `70e7f4`; this task did not reread that result or independently qualify it. Root owns the independent confirmation, integration and any later native admission.

The direction is the committed interrupted-owner brief `77dc339`, amended by repair brief `81635ab`. Prior native runtime-owner cancellation is `3b8f9e0`; earlier retired-owner recovery is `5671b51`. These cover different histories. This proposal interrupts an admitted operation while its worker is still retained. It does not simulate a controller crash or operating-system interrupt.

Use the 29 native source names in `SOURCE-MAP.json`: 25 unchanged texts, the three frozen repair02 replacements, and a new bootstrap derivative. The frozen replacements are `durable_lifecycle.py` at `3c8963ea`, `generated_adapter_flow.py` at `6a008136`, and `generated_journal_setup.py` at `44bdaeeb`; full hashes and paths are in the map. The native baseline is bootstrap `2b3ff164` and launcher `8f1a5c2e`, with source map `59f9e0d3`. The old retired bootstrap diff supplies the small probe/observer routing pattern, not its old timing or four-frame assertions.

Minimal preparation changes:

| Surface | Exact proposed delta |
| --- | --- |
| Source payloads | Copy the three frozen replacements; preserve the other 25 source texts, including the actual runtime-owner child, bridge, factory, registry, parser and closed real entry points. No core repair is identified as necessary for routing. |
| Bootstrap location and authority | Give the fresh derivative one fixed run path, `positive` adoption and `drain` mode. The interrupted controller requires `drain`; retaining the old `cancel` mode would refuse. Use a distinct schema/scope and false template. Rebuild source/control hashes. |
| Controller selection | After the existing journal connection and contender binding, construct `FLOW._InterruptedOperationProbe(port, journal_setup)`, bind it with `port._bind_interrupted_probe`, invoke `FLOW.controller_interrupted_recovery_flow(port)`, then `journal_setup.complete_interrupted_recovery()`. Preserve `child_runtime_owner_flow` selection. |
| Journal-close selection | Replace only the instrument's `journal_setup.before_close(args)` selection at baseline bootstrap line 560 with `before_interrupted_close(args)`. Keep ordinary source methods and assertions unchanged. |
| Failure reporting | At baseline bootstrap lines 632–636, preserve the first caught exception if the subsequent quarantine attempt also fails. Record that secondary failure without replacing the primary error or skipping the bounded failure receipt. This is an instrument reporting refinement, not permission to recover an uncertain operation. |
| Launcher | Retain source/support/fixture preparation and actual-exit recording; write a distinct interrupted observation verifier as described below. Preserve the original cancellation/retired launchers and their assertions. |
| Controls | Regenerate the 29-source map, launcher binding and false template. A later root-created original admission must remain separately hashed before/after and copied as `ROOT-ADMISSION.json`, preserving 32 source/control pairs. Suggested fresh proposal/run names are `windows-interrupted-owner-native-proposal01` and `windows-interrupted-owner-retirement01`; they have not been created or checked here. |

The controller must publish one segment to its caller, then receive the second complete generated segment and raise the exact fixed `KeyboardInterrupt` before returning it. The four operation actions are admit, begin, next, next; there is no cursor-cancel or EOF request. The actual adapter context unwinds, revokes/quarantines the owner and confirms the fourth journal frame. The explicit coordinator then uses the same manager attempt, retained bindings and post-quarantine revision to observe worker exit, close confirmed individual handles and reconcile the fifth frame. Aggregate quarantine flags and old owner/token revocation remain true.

The acceptance contract must distinguish two processes. Require complete guarded controller and contender receipts with the retained 12 metadata traps, 25 registry traps, 33 fixed API bindings, dispatch accounting, unchanged source hashes, no denials and no pending parent I/O. The contender still refuses its one journal open with error 32 and exits 0 with an empty job. For the primary worker, require the controller's retained-process wait, exit code 1 and empty owned job, with exactly one primary job termination and no second stop. Code 1 is the existing fixed quarantine termination value, not a fabricated child return value.

The child may be terminated while waiting for its next frame. Its normal final JSON, final guard observation, Python finally path, completed factory/read-set retirement, closed frame and final owner revocation are therefore not available evidence. Preserve any partial child receipt if one appears; never synthesize one or credit it as clean. A successfully received second authenticated reply supports the executed path through the bound child source, but does not establish a final child-state measurement. If root requires that measurement, this minimal observation is insufficient and needs a separately reviewed progress/acknowledgement design before execution. Do not delay termination merely to manufacture a clean final report.

Require five ordered phases and successful flushes: `INITIALIZED`, `RESERVED`, `WORKER_BOUND`, `QUARANTINED`, `CLEARED`. Decode the recorded journal bytes, bind the four-frame prefix hash and post-quarantine head/revision, and verify the fifth predecessor, close milestone, handle/gate retirement and released manager record. Retain the original exclusive, bounded postexit journal comparison and before/copy/after source checks for the later admitted invocation. No physical journal is read by this planning task. Keep the two-create/two-resume contender/primary ordering, five locked then five post-retirement write probes, exact parent policy/ack/manifest checks and restored controller adapter state. Do not invent deterministic final journal size or total call count before observation.

The new controller correctly reports adapter unwind before explicit cleanup. Its current `parent_guards_held_through_exit` field is false, unlike the old wrapper's required true value. The new verifier must not silently reverse or reinterpret it. Use the retained-witness/process-before-close ordering for the actual retirement claim, and have root resolve that passive field's wording/value in a documented reporting refinement if it is to be used. The existing child-owner event list and child readback totals likewise cannot be carried over as final observations of a terminated child.

Keep the current startup registry trap, closed content/metadata/import sets, verified DLL dispatch and both-endpoint pending-I/O finalizer intact. No new native API or generated file is needed. Copy the nine support identities as metadata only during preparation; later verification of their actual bytes belongs to an admitted invocation. Keep the original 16,384-call/60-second cooperative work window and 64-call/10-second cleanup reserve. The reserve excludes process/job queries, ordinary handle retirement and journal flushes once work closes; this scenario must finish under the original work budget or refuse and retain uncertainty. Do not expand the reserve to force a pass.

Next action: prepare only the new bootstrap, launcher, false template and protocol under a separate source proposal; root and peer review their exact deltas and the outcome contract after fake28 confirmation. No additional test framework or assertion rewrite is proposed. All native/support access, generated fixture/journal creation and process execution remain unapproved here. D3 acquisition, D4 ML, real PCM/filter/loader activation, checkpoint/D2 output, index/5179 access, restart, power-loss, website and marketing remain outside this unit.

`reads/` retains the real text-read and binding tool objects. The source map distinguishes observed text hashes from inherited support metadata and lists actual view ranges. It is not an executable manifest or an admission.

# Dormant native cancellation protocol

This file describes one future observation. It does not admit or execute it. The fixed proposal is _scratch/runtime-owner-native-connection-native-proposal01; the fixed fresh run is _scratch/runtime-owner-native-connection01. Only positive adoption and operation mode cancel are supported. Root must create ROOT-ADMISSION-cancel.json separately; the false template stays unchanged.

The launcher binds the 29 source files, SOURCE-INPUTS.json, itself and the exact original admission. It verifies and copies those controls, then creates five fixed ASCII fixtures and an empty registry directory. The nine installed support pins retain their prior paths, sizes and hashes. Only a later admitted invocation may verify those support bytes. No checkpoint, converted output, live index or real cache is in the source map or runtime path set.

The proposed command uses the observed PowerShell 7 executable at C:\Users\hello\.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\native\powershell\pwsh.exe with -NoProfile -File pointing to run_native_owner_cancel01.ps1 and -taskMode cancel. IG_FORBIDDEN_LIVE must already equal C:\Users\hello\AppData\Local\Uoink\index.db before outer startup. The caller must preserve its complete actual tool object and explicitly propagate global LASTEXITCODE. Do not execute this description as part of preparation.

The launcher retains the reviewed immediate native-exit block: it disables inherited native-command error promotion, captures the actual global exit after the Python controller returns, durably records it before postchecks and rejects noninteger capture. Python runs with -I -S -B. Offline, disabled backend autoload and disabled metrics settings remain fixed. The child and contender are created through the existing owned process/job path.

The child must complete authenticated challenge, exact inherited adoption and policy acknowledgement before begin. It then materializes only the five generated files, builds and registers the actual factory with fake tensor services, publishes one fixed segment under owner/PCM/VAD checks, and accepts cursor cancellation. The controller observes the same WORKER_BOUND token and journal handle before and after cursor cancellation. The adapter's original finally path owns stop, join, durable clear and physical gate retirement.

PASS requires the original cancellation checks plus the appended owner checks: all three guarded receipts, unchanged original/copied controls and support/fixture bytes, exact four operation actions, one segment, actual primary and contender exit 0 with empty jobs, four ordered journal phases and flushes, no pending pipe operations, and an exclusive postexit read matching the confirmed bounded journal. The owner's fixed event sequence must show registration before publication and retirement before read-set release, closed write and revocation. Retained generated references are intentional and do not assert native memory reclamation.

Keep all partial receipts, stdout/stderr, native and outer outcomes on failure. The passive owner receipt may show incomplete state; it must not be relabeled successful. There is no automatic rerun or budget increase. Early pre-begin cancellation and failure injection remain covered only by the fake cases; this native observation selects ordinary cancellation after one segment. It makes no combined retired-recovery, real model, decoding, power-loss or restart claim.
